questions.question: When the LORD heard the great outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah, what did He say He would do?

answers.text: Go down and see if their actions fit the outcry
Wipe out both cities before the sun goes down
Leave the two cities alone until next year

questions.question: When Abraham pleaded for the righteous people of Sodom, what title did he give the LORD?

answers.text: The Judge of all the earth

questions.question: Abraham asked the LORD about fifty righteous people in Sodom. What did the LORD say He would do on their account?
In his last plea to save Sodom, Abraham asked the LORD about how many righteous people?
